newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan tourism receipts at $1.2 billion in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan tourism receipts at $1.2 billion in 1996.

text.p: Morocco's tourism receipts totalled about 11.5 billion dirhams ($1.26 billion) in 1996, up 16 percent, compared to 9.9 billion dirhams in 1995, according to provisional official estimates.
The tourism ministry, in provional data quoted by the official Moroccan news agency MAP, said 1996 earnings neared the record receipts of 1992, 11.7 billion dirhams.
About 1.65 million foreign tourists visited Morocco in 1996 compared to 1.52 million in 1995, said MAP, adding that officials expected the final figures would be better than the released estimates.
